proof_body:
by
  intro g c R hR hg h0
  have hc : c ∈ Metric.ball c R := Metric.mem_ball_self hR
  have hq : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => deriv g z / g z) (Metric.ball c R) := (hg.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball).div hg h0
  obtain ⟨F, hF0, hF⟩ := (DifferentiableOn.isExactOn_ball hq).with_val_at c (Complex.log (g c))
  refine ⟨F, fun z hz => (hF z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt, ?_⟩
  have hk : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => g z * Complex.exp (-F z)) (Metric.ball c R) := by
    refine hg.mul (DifferentiableOn.cexp (DifferentiableOn.neg ?_))
    exact fun z hz => (hF z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hd : Set.EqOn (deriv fun z => g z * Complex.exp (-F z)) 0 (Metric.ball c R) := by
    intro z hz
    have hgz : HasDerivAt g (deriv g z) z := (hg.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
    have h1 := hgz.mul ((hF z hz).neg.cexp)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z => g z * Complex.exp (-F z)) (deriv g z * Complex.exp (-F z) + g z * (Complex.exp (-F z) * -(deriv g z / g z))) z := h1
    rw [h2.deriv]
    have := h0 z hz
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    field_simp
    ring
  intro z hz
  have h3 := Metric.isOpen_ball.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (convex_ball c R).isPreconnected hk hd hz hc
  simp only [hF0, Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_log (h0 c hc)] at h3
  have hgc := h0 c hc
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hgc] at h3
  have h4 : g z = Complex.exp (F z) := by
    have he := Complex.exp_ne_zero (F z)
    field_simp at h3
    exact h3
  exact h4.symm
target_source: ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball c R) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R, g z ≠ 0) → ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball c R) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R, Complex.exp (f z) = g z
